reviews.text: Suggestions.. After using hyper for a few days alongside its competition I have been pleasantly impressed. Hyper is the newest of the few Vtuber-on-the-go apps available for mobile devices. It offers a clean interface that is easy to use. Talent is highlighted neatly in the top corner upon opening the app, amongst other valuable information and promotions, unlike the messy interfaces of the competition. The environment on hyper from my experience has been nothing short of embracing and encouraging, especially to the noobies. Now if I had a few suggestion to make this app even better I would love to see the implementation of the ability to go live with friends or invite audience member onto your stream, as is available in the competing apps. Going live by yourself is fun but inviting others to join you is better sometimes. Another suggestion I would make is more items for character customization, this is self explanatory. I would like to see better cohesion between the PC version and mobile versions of hyper as I’ve been told it’s hard for PC users to engage or even add mobile users as friends at times. And finally, the latency issue, sometimes hyper plays nice and sometimes it will lag and crash, as this is a new app I can be lenient on this issue but I would really like to see an improvement on connectivity problems as this platform grows. But to summarize, great platform, easy to use, friendly environment, a bit buggy at times and lack of wardrobe choice and lack of shared streaming but overall much potential.

Great potential, but…. Having a vtuber app where we can customize our avatars and make videos is something I’ve always dreamed of. I’ll be completely honest with you, I’m terribly shy and ugly irl so having the chance to play the role of a pretty anime character opens up a whole new world of possibilities for me. The tracking is very impressive, especially considering that I have to wear glasses irl since I’m as blind as a bat. 

However, there are several issues that are bothering me. I use iOS on an iPad and my avatar’s neck snaps to the side and the head won’t stay on straight. I haven’t been able to figure out a consistent work around for this problem, and I don’t want to start streaming until it is fixed because I’m really worried that it will make me look unprofessional, or even worse, creepy. There are also times when the program randomly freezes and crashes. I’m also very confused about how to link my YouTube account. 

If/when these issues are addressed and fixed, I would be more than happy to change my rating to a solid 5 stars. I really want to see this app thrive and grow and for lots of people like me to become vtubers!!
